questions.title: Ohm's law and current
questions.model_solution: For a 12 V source across a 4 ohm resistor, I=V/R=12/4=3 A. Accept any equivalent correct method, with correct units.

deductions.label: Incorrect law or formula
deductions.detail: Deduct only if the selected law or rearrangement is fundamentally incorrect.

deductions.label: Arithmetic error
deductions.detail: One arithmetic deduction per question; follow-through errors are not repeatedly penalized.
